entries.zh:
§H帝国权威§E代表了统领国对整个星海帝国的掌控程度。每个月，被指派的代表都能提升这个数值§G+$CHANGE$§!或降低$NEG_CHANGE|R$乘以§Y技能等级§!点。这也会对帝国统领国的评价产生影响。§!§!

§H如果低于§Y50§!：§!
成员国能够通过一项谍报行动触发一场针对统领国的叛乱。

§H如果高于§Y100§!：§!
整个帝国在面对外敌的防御战争中将同统领国并肩作战。

§H如果高于§Y140§!：§!
可以发动大远征，强迫目标国家并入星海帝国。

§H如果高于§Y180§!：§!
可以提议“星海帝国治下的和平”议案，禁止帝国属邦之间的战争。
entries.en:
§HImperial Authority§E represents how tight the ruler's grasp is on the Imperium. Each month, assigned Delegates raise it by §G+$CHANGE$§! or lower it by $NEG_CHANGE|R$ multiplied by their §YSkill Level§!. This also has an effect on the Imperium ruler's Opinion.§!§!

§HIf below §Y50§!:§!
Members can trigger a rebellion against the ruler through an espionage operation.

§HIf above §Y100§!:§!
The entire Imperium joins the ruler in any defensive wars against outsiders.

§HIf above §Y140§!:§!
Imperial Crusades can be proposed to force target empires into the Imperium.

§HIf above §Y180§!:§!
The Pax Galactica resolution can be proposed to ban wars between Imperial states.

entries.zh: 增强帝国权威
entries.en: Strengthen Imperial Authority

entries.zh: 指派一名我们的代表来团结星海帝国将会逐渐增加帝国权威。\n\n他们在执行这项任务的同时也会提升我们的§Y外交权重§!
entries.en: Assigning our Delegate to strengthen the Galactic Imperium will increase Imperial Authority over time.\n\nThey will perform this duty in addition to increasing our §YDiplomatic Weight§!.

entries.zh: 削弱帝国权威

entries.en: Assigning our Delegate to undermine the Galactic Imperium will decrease Imperial Authority over time.\n\nThey will perform this duty in addition to increasing our §YDiplomatic Weight§!.

entries.en: §HAssign Delegate to Undermine the Imperium§!\nThey will perform this duty in addition to increasing our §YDiplomatic Weight§!.

entries.zh: §E代表可以在帝国参议院公开批评或者支持帝国及其政策。这一行为将会逐渐地提高或降低§H帝国权威§E，并影响到同帝国统领国之间的关系。§!§!§!
entries.en: §EDelegates can openly criticize or support the Imperium and its policies in the Imperial Senate. This will increase or decrease §HImperial Authority§E over time, and will impact relations with the Imperium's ruler.§!§!§!

entries.zh: §H泛星系防卫军舰队§!是由星海监管人指挥控制的特战舰队。它们在§H泛星系防卫军舰船设计器§!中进行设计，可以使用任何星海共同体成员已经研发的科技。泛星系防卫军舰队不需要维护费，但规模不能超过§H泛星系防卫军海军容量§!，后者根据共同体的议案进行调节。
entries.en: §HGalactic Defense Force Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the Galactic Custodian. They are designed in the §HGalactic Defense Force Ship Designer§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Galactic Community. Galactic Defense Force Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HGalactic Defense Force Naval Capacity§!, which can be changed through Resolutions.

entries.zh: §H帝国海军舰队§!是由星海帝国的统领国直辖的特战舰队。它们在§H帝国舰队舰船设计器§!中进行设计，能够使用任何星海帝国成员已经研发的科技。帝国舰队不需要维护费，但是其规模不能超出§H帝国舰队海军容量§!，后者根据星海帝国的议案调节。
entries.en: §HImperial Armada Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the ruler of the Galactic Imperium. They are designed in the §HImperial Armada Ship Designer§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Galactic Imperium. Imperial Armada Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HImperial Armada Naval Capacity§!, which can be changed through Resolutions.

entries.zh: 我们荣光加身的帝皇陛下认定§H[Root.GetName]§!应当在帝国议会享有一席之地
entries.en: Their Imperial Majesty has decided that §H[Root.GetName]§! should have a seat in the Imperial Council

entries.en: Added to the Imperial Council

entries.en: Kicked From Imperial Council

entries.zh: 得亏于我们在$COUNTRY$的朋友，我们可以恢复星海共同体的光荣和完整性了。
entries.en: With the help of our friends in the $COUNTRY$, we can restore the honor and integrity of the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 麻烦了，请协助我们同其他人讲讲道理。作为监管人，我们需要一切可以用得着的帮助。
entries.en: Please, help us make the others see reason. As Custodians we need all the help we can get.

entries.zh: 确实，如果不是$COUNTRY$倾力耕耘，星海共同体很久之前就倒台了。你作为监管人，让我们感到骄傲。
entries.en: Truly, the Galactic Community would have collapsed long ago if not for the efforts of the $COUNTRY$. You make us proud to be Custodians.

entries.zh: 作为监管人，我们认为这项议案代表着全星系的最佳利益。
entries.en: As Custodians, we consider this resolution to be in the galaxy's best interest.

entries.zh: 监管人身份是非常重大的责任，但是如果我们可以通过这项改革，那么我们的努力就没有白费。
entries.en: The Custodianship is a great responsibility to bear, but if we can pass these reforms it will have been worth it.

entries.zh: 我们打算使用监管人身份改革共同体，使其变得更好。
entries.en: We intend to use this Custodianship to reform the Community for the better.

entries.zh: 如果不是有像$COUNTRY$这样的捣蛋分子，共同体也无需设置监管人。现在，做点正事，支持这项议案。
entries.en: If not for troublesome members such as the $COUNTRY$, there would be no need for a Custodianship. Now do the right thing for once and support this resolution.

entries.zh: 作为监管人，我们通过战斗保护共同体免受像你这样的太空渣滓的侵害。我们会使用权力从各方面遏制你的影响力，以免共同体受你破坏。
entries.en: As Custodians, we are fighting to save the Community from scum like you. We will do everything in our power to limit your corrupting influence.

entries.zh: 你确定自己想要同星海的监管人维持不友好的关系？请仔细考虑，反对这项提案是否符合你方的最佳利益……
entries.en: Do you really want to remain on unfriendly terms with the Galactic Custodians? Consider carefully if it is in your best interest to oppose this resolution...

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$是帝国列位属国中最为忠诚的一员，鉴于此，我方期待你方对此事予以支持。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ are among the most loyal of the Imperium's subject nations, and as such, we expect your support in this.

entries.zh: 帝国依仗强大的$COUNTRY$作出正确抉择，支持我们的提案。
entries.en: The Imperium depends on the great $COUNTRY$ to do the right thing and support our resolution.

entries.zh: 团结一致，我们将使帝国更为强大。
entries.en: Together we will strengthen the Imperium.

entries.zh: 仅公示知涵。请对帝国法令表示支持。
entries.en: A mere formality. Please lend your support to this Imperial decree.

entries.zh: 这项提案对加强帝国的势力、削弱敌人的伎俩是至关重要的……无论是内部还是外部的敌人。
entries.en: This resolution is necessary to strengthen the Imperium and thwart the efforts of its enemies... both foreign and domestic.

entries.zh: 星海帝国需要你签字。
entries.en: The Galactic Imperium requires your signature.

entries.zh: 作为帝国属邦，我方要求你在此事上表现顺从。
entries.en: As Imperial subjects, we demand your obedience in this matter.

entries.zh: 你为了自己的蝇头小利损害了我们的权威。$COUNTRY$的未来将很大程度上取决于你此时此地的行为。
entries.en: You undermine our authority at your own peril. The future of the $COUNTRY$ will largely depend on your actions here.

entries.zh: 噢。是$COUNTRY$……星海帝国的臭水沟区。
entries.en: Ah, the $COUNTRY$... the provincial backwater of the Galactic Imperium.

entries.zh: 我们勒令你重新考虑。作为监管人，我们能在很多方面对你有所作为。
entries.en: We urge you to reconsider. As Custodians, there is much we can do for you.

entries.zh: 我可以保证，$COUNTRY$的最高利益我们是放在心上的！请重新考虑一下吧。
entries.en: I can guarantee that we have the best interests of the $COUNTRY$ in mind! Please reconsider.

entries.zh: 朋友，肯定有什么误会。我们指望你的支持！
entries.en: There must be some mistake, friends. We are counting on your support!

entries.zh: 你的反对是在威胁削弱星海监管人的权力。
entries.en: Your opposition is threatening to undermine the power of the Galactic Custodianship.

entries.zh: 这份提案对于星海共同体的未来休戚相关。作为监管人，我们不会轻易作出此等论断！
entries.en: This resolution is critical to the future of the Galactic Community. As Custodians, we don't say that lightly!

entries.zh: 没有最低限度的帮助，我们不能改革共同体。你难道真想看到这个高贵的体制堕落，任由共同体陷入一片混乱，腐败渐渐蔓延吗？
entries.en: We can't reform the Community without at least some help. Do you truly want this noble institution to descend into anarchy and corruption?

entries.zh: 你真是个憨批，居然反对星海监管人。
entries.en: You are fools to oppose the Galactic Custodians.

entries.zh: 你最好好自为之，要牢记我们作为监管人有着很大的能量……这股能量也可以用来对付你。
entries.en: You would do well to remember that as Custodians, we have a great deal of influence... which could be leveraged against you.

entries.zh: 你会反对我怎么一点也不意外呢！毕竟，如果我们改革了共同体，消灭了腐败，像你这样的虫豸又能去往何处遁形？
entries.en: Of course you oppose this! After all, if we were to reform the Community and eliminate its corruption, where would vermin like you go?

entries.zh: 给我小心点。在此之前，你可是一直被视作帝国忠诚属民的。
entries.en: Careful now. Up until now, you have been regarded as loyal subjects of the Imperium.

entries.zh: 你确定要因为此事，抛弃你在帝国内受恩宠的地位？当真？
entries.en: You would throw away your favored status within the Imperium over this? Truly?

entries.zh: 在我们予以你那么多恩惠之后，你居然选择这个时刻来忤逆我们？你是不是疯了？
entries.en: After everything we have done for you, you pick THIS moment to defy us? Have you gone mad?

entries.zh: 星海帝国的成员国能够分为两类：赢得了我们恩宠的……以及没有赢得我们恩宠的。
entries.en: The member states of the Galactic Imperium can be divided into two categories: those who have won our favor... and those who have not.

entries.zh: 反对这项提案会伤害帝国，也就是说会伤害$COUNTRY$。我们对此很确信。
entries.en: Opposing this resolution will hurt the Imperium, and that means it will hurt the $COUNTRY$. We will make certain of that.

entries.zh: 如果帝国想要胜利，我们必须戮力齐心，看向同一个方向。请好好考虑。
entries.en: If the Imperium is to succeed, we must all be pulling in the same direction. Consider that.

entries.zh: 你敢？
entries.en: You DARE?

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$着实是帝国最为下作的行省。我们的星海怎么有这么一片邪恶和懒惰之角隅。
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ is truly the most wretched of the Imperium's provinces. What a vile and loathsome corner of our galaxy.

entries.zh: 唯有星海帝国的敌人才会反对这项提案……不过，或许这样的描述对$COUNTRY$来说恰到好处？
entries.en: Only an enemy of the Galactic Imperium would oppose this resolution... but perhaps that is a fitting description of the $COUNTRY$?

entries.zh: 我们靠你的支持才做成这事的。如果没有我们最给力的老朋友鼎力相助，我们作为监管人又能做得了什么呢？
entries.en: We were counting on your support. How are we to get anything done as Custodians when not even our supposed friends back our resolutions?

entries.zh: 星海共同体能变得比今天更加美好。你难道意识不到吗？
entries.en: The Galactic Community can be so much more than it is today. Can't you see that?

entries.zh: 呆瓜玩意。无论有没有$COUNTRY$相助，我们都将改革星海共同体。
entries.en: Stubborn fools. We WILL reform the Galactic Community, with or without the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 你在参议院反对我们的提案，我们又怎么能宣扬$COUNTRY$作为帝国美德和忠诚的典范呢？你让我们很难办。
entries.en: How can we promote the $COUNTRY$ as an example of Imperial virtue and loyalty when you oppose our resolutions in the Senate? You are making things very difficult for us.

entries.zh: 对我们的提案表达反对意见是一个致命的错误。帝国期待你表现更好一点。
entries.en: Voicing your opposition to our resolution was a grave error. The Imperium expects better of you.

entries.zh: 不忠的渣滓。你妄图削弱帝国的行为是没用的，帝国将会长存。
entries.en: Disloyal scum. The Imperium will survive your futile attempts to undermine it.

entries.zh: 我们就知道可以指望$COUNTRY$的支持。有了你方的助力，星海共同体能够改革，未来更上一层楼。
entries.en: We knew we could count on the support of the $COUNTRY$. With your help, the Galactic Community will be reformed into something far greater than it is today.

entries.zh: 感谢你支持我们作为监管人的艰苦工作。还有许多议案需要通过呢。
entries.en: Thank you for supporting our difficult work as Custodians. There are many resolutions to be passed.

entries.zh: 很高兴你方能够搁置双边争议，着眼我们作为星海监管人的重要工作。
entries.en: It is good that you were able to put our differences aside and support the important work we are doing as Galactic Custodians.

entries.zh: $COUNTRY$在帝国的持续成功中扮演着重要的角色。实至名归！
entries.en: The $COUNTRY$ has played an important part in the continued success of the Imperium. Let no one claim otherwise!

entries.zh: 帝国已经注意到了$COUNTRY$忠心耿耿的支持。
entries.en: The Imperium has noted the loyal support of the $COUNTRY$.

entries.zh: 你方最近对我们的提案表示支持，这是一个正面的信号。浪子回头，重新成为忠诚而有贡献的帝国子民，尚且不迟。
entries.en: Your recent support of our resolutions is a positive sign. Perhaps it is not too late for you to turn into loyal and productive Imperial citizens.
